name: NAATTILE SCENE — ഇത് കേരളമാണ്! (Kizhakkumpuram 3D Open World)
description: Explore an authentic Kerala village in an interactive 3D open world featuring swaying palms, chaya kada culture, peaceful mosque, KSRTC buses, Babu's auto rickshaw, Kizhakkumpuram Sevens Stadium, and a breathtaking Lotus Pond (താമരക്കുളം) with natural river boulder shoreline, clear turquoise water, floating lily pads, blooming flowers, and swimming koi fish.
